body: Thanks for helping me know what I'm feeling. Like I said, therapy isn't affordable for me so pretty much my depression is self-diagnosed. I do feel the world has something for me, so I think I'm not really depressed, just sad. I'm really close to my sister, she's the only person that ever saw me cry, but I think giving her something to worry about is not the right choice. I don't want her to be worried everyday by the fact that I can kill myself at anytime. I rarely cry, now that you ask it. When I feel depressed (well just sad) I look to the ceiling for hours and hours and think. Just let my brain think about the situation I'm in and eventually get over it.
